text:
maya: quick flag  ran into a rotation race in the sampleapp while prepping a demo. rotated the project key and a few streaming clients still got 401s for ~25-40s.

sam: likely stale header somewhere on the client side. which SDK version? any caching layers?

maya: using node SDK v0.9.3. we added a tiny credential cache to avoid KMS roundtrips; streamer keeps a ref to the token and doesn't re-read per-request. cache TTL is 45s so visible gap.

liz: that explains it. streams keeping a pointer -> even after cache entry updates the stream uses old object. we should either rebind per-request or expose an invalidate hook.

ash: exposing an event seems cleaner for perf. creds.on('update', cb) so long-lived components can swap headers atomically. avoids adding per-token allocations on hot paths.

maya: +1. prototype idea: CredStore emits an event when update() is called (either local rotate or control-plane webhook). streaming client subscribes and swaps auth header via stream.replaceAuth(new).

sam: make sure the API covers both static keys and ephemeral/KMS tokens (refresh flow). tests should simulate rotation mid-stream and assert no 401s.

liz: another note: sampleapp docs say use REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY but node SDK reads REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT. onboarding mismatch causing folks to rotate wrong env var. we need parity across SDKs and docs.

maya: ugh, yes. new users rotate "project" key in console but SDK picks up different env var name. can cause silent fallback to org key and weird billing attribution.

ash: proposal: normalize on REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY across all SDKs + sampleapps. add a compatibility shim that reads REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT too but logs a deprecation warning for 12 months. also add CLI warning if both are set.

sam: sounds good. action items: (1) add CredStore 'update' event + unit tests; (2) patch streaming client to subscribe and atomically swap auth; (3) update sampleapp README and SDK env var parsing; (4) migration plan + deprecation message.

maya: I'll add a tiny integration test that opens 5 streams, triggers a rotate, and asserts zero 401s during the swap window. will also add a small repro snippet in the sampleapp repo.

liz: ops/sre note: routing currently sometimes falls back to org key on auth failures which causes metrics attribution to flip. we need a signal in control-plane logs to differentiate "stale project key" vs "invalid token" so billing doesn't get noisy.

ash: agreed. i'll file a runtime ticket to add a distinct error code when a request authenticated with project key returns 401 due to stale key vs when it retries with org key. ops-bot: ping @eng-platform.

ops-bot: filed PLATFORM-2981 and tagged @eng-platform. remember to include integration test link.

sam: i'll open PR for the event API and streaming client patch. maya add the sampleapp doc commit and test refs and i'll coordinate the env var deprecation blurb.

maya: on it. will push everything to a small branch and link PRs here. thanks :thumbsup:

liz: assigning: sam -> PR + tests; maya -> sampleapp + repro test + docs; ash -> runtime logs/attribution audit.

ash: checking Dedicated/private flows for webhook differences (HSM/KMS) as well. will report any divergence.

maya: great, please also add a short note in sampleapp onboarding about how to rotate keys during demos to avoid surprises.

sam: noted. short-term mitigation: add a warning in the sampleapp startup logs if credential cache TTL > 0 and streams are active.

maya: perfect. thanks everyone.
